name: streambox-rag-qa
description: Questions that must be answered from the StreamBox help documents.

inputs.question: How many days do I have to ask for a refund?

outputs.answer: You can ask for a refund within 14 days of your first payment.

inputs.question: How long does a refund take to reach my bank?

outputs.answer: The money goes back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 working days.

inputs.question: Can I get a refund on a gift card?

outputs.answer: No. Gift cards cannot be refunded.

inputs.question: How much does the Premium plan cost?
How many screens can I watch on with the Standard plan?

outputs.answer: Standard lets you watch on two screens at a time.

inputs.question: How long is the password reset link valid?

outputs.answer: The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

inputs.question: How many devices can I sign in on with one account?

outputs.answer: You can sign in on up to 6 devices on one account.

inputs.question: How long do downloads stay on my device?

outputs.answer: Downloaded episodes stay on your device for 30 days.
